page_note: Pure cosmological substrate throughout. The page describes (1) the binding/affliction of the darkness powers, the molding of Adam and Eve, (2) the Call and the Answer (Great Counsel) descending to the elements, (3) the eschatological gathering and final destruction (anareias), the Living Spirit/Father bringing the soul up, and (4) the milk-and-hotstone analogy explaining how Call and Answer work. Voice is impersonal-cosmic-mythological throughout; no apostolic frame, no exhortation, no institutional or polemical vocabulary. Heavy lacunae but recoverable as substrate. Teaching purity 1.000.
